0022600156.text: The Golden State Warriors host the LA Clippers in their seventh game of the season, with the Warriors at 2-3 on a two-game winning streak, second in the Pacific and tenth in the West. The Clippers are 1-4 and on a four-game losing streak, sitting 14th in the West. The Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery).
